dug lnga dug gsum rig pa'i ngang du mā ra ya sod sod swāhā/ zhes pa dang ye shes rnam pa lngas bskor ba ni gzhi mi 'gyur ba'i thig le chen po'o/ /zhes btags pas grol ba'i snying po bstan pa'i le'u ste drug pa rdzogs so// / / ༈ da ni le'u bdun pa 'grol te/ e ma ho/ zhes pa'i don ni/ e zhes pa chos sku 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /ma zhes pa longs sku 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /ho zhes pa sprul sku 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /de ltar 'dus ma byas kyi rang sgra 'dus ma byas pas ngo mtshar che'o/ /bcom pa dang ni ldan pa dang*/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ bcom pa zhes pa ma rig pa/ dang ni zhes pa dug lnga dug gsum/ ldan pa dang zhes pa sku gsum ye shes lnga dang*/ 'das pa yang dag lam yin no/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ 'das pa zhes pa ma rig pa las/ yang dag ces pa rig pa/ lam yin no zhes pa ka dag gi 'di tshig lam min gdams pa yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ 'di tshig ces pa sangs rgyas gcig pa'o/ /lam min zhes pa da bsgrub dgos pa lta bu min pas so/ /gdams pa yin zhes pa gsung 'dus ma byas phrad pas chog pa'i/ bstan cing bshad med brjod ma yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ bstan cing zhes pa dngos por/ bshad med ces pa 'khor lo/ brjod ma yin zhes pa ston pa gang gis kyang*/ gdams pa ma yin byin rlabs yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ gdams pa zhes pa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i/ ma yin zhes pa dang po nas/ byin rlabs yin zhes pa 'dus ma byas pa ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum gyi/ bris shing bkod med rang byung yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ bris shing zhes pa yi ge ris su/ bkod med ces pa gang zag gis/ rang byung yin zhes pa sangs rgyas sgom ste ma mdzad/ sems can sgrin pos ma bcos te byas pa med pa'i/ gnas dang dus med sngon thog yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ gnas dang zhes pa gang du/ dus med ces pa 'das ma 'ongs da lta gsum/ sngon thog yin zhes pa dran pa kun gyi/

chos min snying po thugs gsang yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ chos min zhes pa ston pas gsungs pa'i/ snying po zhes pa bstan pa thams cad kyi/ thugs gsang yin zhes pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ sus kyang nyan med rang shar yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ sus kyang zhes pa phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i/ nyan med ces pa rna ba'i dbang pos/ rang shar yin zhes pa thig le nyag gcig tu/ thos pa med cing rang bsgrags yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ thos pa zhes pa rna ba'i dbang pos/ med cing zhes pa 'byung bzhi rang sdebs kyi sgra/ rang bsgrags yin zhes pa sgra 'dus ma byas chos nyid mngon sum mo/ /byas pas 'di kun ma yin tshig /ces pa'i don ni/ byas pas zhes pa yid dpyod tshig gis bshad mi shes so/ /'di kun zhes pa bstan pa thams cad kyi bu gcig po'i tshig / ma yin tshig ces pa 'dus ma byas/ 'di yod 'gro ba sangs rgyas yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ 'di yod ces pa chos nyid kyi rang sgra/ 'dus ma byas sangs rgyas sras gcig po/ 'gro ba zhes pa dbugs can/ sangs rgyas yin zhes pa bral chen po rig pas grol ba/ ba mo la nyi ma phog pa lta bus/ pha rol mthong ba'i gsang chen lam/ / zhes pa'i don ni/ pha rol zhes pa 'khrul snang rang 'gags la sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal skye shi bor len 'di'i/ mthong ba'i zhes pa sku gsum ye rdzogs ye shes lnga ldan gyi snang ba/ gsang chen lam zhes pa ma bsgoms rgyud btags pa'i byin rlabs kyi/ yon tan rang babs su byung ba nam zla dros pa lta bu'o/ /sems yod ma yin sprul pa yin/ / zhes pa'i don ni/ sems yod ces pas zin med pa'i 'gro ba/ yod pa la med par sems/ med pa la yod par sems 'dus byas 'jig pa'i chos can/ ma yin zhes pa rgyud 'di yod pa'i skal pa can te/ sprul pa yin zhes pa 'dus ma byas kun bzang yab yum gyi/ 'khor ba'i spyi mdud grol ba'o/ /zhes pa'i don ni/

'khor ba'i zhes pa khams gsum du/ spyi mdun ces pa gzung 'dzin gnyis/ grol ba'o zhes pa rgyud 'dis dbugs la sleb pa tsam gyis mun khung du mar me bteg pa'am mkha' la nyi ma shar ba ltar/ shes bya ma yin lam sna thag /ces pa'i don ni/ shes bya zhes pa yid dpyod kyi/ ma yin zhes pa rgyud 'di/ lam sna thag ces pa rgyud 'di dang phrad pa dang lam bsgrod pa dus mnyam pas so/ /stong pa ma yin mngon sum yul/ / zhes pa'i don ni/ stong pa zhes pa cang med chad lta/ ma yin zhes pa rgyud 'di/ mngon sum yul zhes pa sku gsum yid dpyod la rags ma las pas/ yod med ma yin thabs gsang ba/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ yod med ces pa rtag chad gnyis/ ma yin zhes pa rgyud 'di/ thabs gsang ba zhes pa btags grol mthong grol ltas grol rnams/ lha med 'di la sngags yod min/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ lha med ces pa blos byas yid bsgom gyi/ 'di la zhes pa rgyud/ sngags yod min zhes pa ming brjod yi ge dang bral bas bzlas pa'i/ pha rol phyin pa drug gi gzhi/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ pha rol zhes pa rtsol byas drug gi phyin pa zhes pa rtsol med/ drug gi gzhi zhes pa sku gsum rang chas kyi sbyin pa/ 'od lnga dri med kyi tshul khrims/ nyon mongs rang grol gyi bzod pa/ cer mthong tshom bu'i brtson 'grus/ 'gyu ba dngos med kyi bsam gtan/ chos zad ka dag gi shes rab bo/ /bsnyen gnas la sogs 'di tshul lo/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ bsnyen gnas zhes pa lus ngag yid gsum dkon mchog gsum la bsnyen pa/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa la gnas pa'o/ /la sogs zhes pa nyis brgya lnga bcu'o/ /'di tshul lo zhes pa rgyud 'di'i/ de bzhin du yang bye brag smra/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ de bzhin zhes pa tshul gyi dbye ba/ du yang zhes pa kha 'dzin/ bye brag smra zhes pa nyan thos pa/ don dam kun rdzob gzugs kyis so/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ don dam gyi don dam dang kun rdzob kyi don dam mo/

/kun rdzob ces pa kun rdzob kyi kun rdzob dang kun rdzob kyi don dam mo/ /gzugs kyis so zhes pa snod bcud gnyis kyi/ rgyud kyi rtsa ba 'di nyid rang*/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ rgyud kyi zhes pa sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi/ rtsa ba zhes pa thams cad kyi/ 'di nyid rang zhes pa rgyud bstan pa'i bu gcig / lha yi rnal 'byor 'di sngags yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ lha'i zhes pa phyi nang gi rnal 'byor zhes pa bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi/ 'di sngags yin zhes pa ma bzlas pa'i srog / lung chen rnams kyi dam pa 'di/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ lung chen zhes pa mdo rgyud/ rnams kyi zhes pa ma lus pa/ dam pa 'di zhes pa snying po/ chos rnams ro gcig 'dres pa'i brten/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ chos rnams zhes pa theg pa dgu'i/ ro gcig ces pa sku gsum du/ 'dres pa'i rten zhes pa gnyis med spang blang med par/ sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ sku gsung zhes pa mdun rgyab tu med par rang gsal brjod du med par chad pa'o/ /thugs kyi zhes pa 'khrul ma myong ba'i dngos med do/ /dbye ba yin zhes pa snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad la/ bla med 'khor lo bskor ba'i gnas/ / zhes pa'i don ni/ bla med ces pa gsang ba/ 'khor lo zhes pa sku gsum gyi chos/ bskor ba'i gnas ba'i gnas zhes pa sku ba zhi'i ye shes lnga'i rabs/ dbang po rnams gyi dmigs gtad yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ dbang po zhes pa lnga/ rnams kyi zhes pa 'gro ba ma lus pa/ dmigs gtad yin zhes pa 'phyugs so med pa'i/ shes rab rnams kyi rtogs pa'i gnas/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ shes rab ces pa yang dag pa'i/ rnams kyi zhes pa gcad byed sgrol byed 'byed byed 'du byed la sogs pa'o/ /rtogs pa'i gnas pa zhes pa sku gsum lhun grub tu/ sku gsum lam du slong ba'i rten/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ sku gsum zhes pa chos sku skye ma myong bas mtha' dang bral/
longs sku 'grib ma myong bas zhi khror gsal/ sprul sku 'gag ma myong bas kun la khyab/ lam du zhes pa skal pa can gyis/ slong ba'i rten zhes pa mngon sum du/ thig le mngon du 'byin pa'i mig

/ces pa'i don ni/ thig le zhes pa sku gsum lhun grub kyi/ mngon du zhes pa dbang po'i/ 'byin pa'i mig ces pa cer mthong sangs rgyas su/ thar pa'i skas kun slong bar byed/ /ces pa'i don ni/ thar pa'i zhes pa khams gsum las/ skas kun zhes pa sku gsum gyi/ slong bar byed ces pa 'khor 'das rang dwangs su/ lam du 'jug pa'i sa mkhan yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ lam du zhes pa yang dag pa'i/ 'jug pa'i zhes pa 'gro ba sems can rnams/ sa mkhan yin zhes pa ma nor bar byed pa ste/ gzhi ma nor ba ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum/ lam ma nor ba sgron ma bzhi/ 'bras bu ma nor ba sku gsum 'dzin zad ka nas dag ga ོ /skal ldan 'dzin pa'i lcags kyur snang*/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ skal ldan zhes pa sangs rgya ba'i/ 'dzin pa'i zhes pa btags pa tsam gyi/ lcags kyur snang zhes pa byin rlabs mngon sum du/ chos sku rang 'jog gnas lugs yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ chos sku zhes pa thig le nyag gcig / rang 'jog ces pa sems can kun la che chung med par/ gnas lugs yin zhes pa ye gdod ma nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag byed gnas/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ sangs rgyas zhes pa sku gsum lam du sangs nas 'bras bu ka dag tu rgyas pa'o/ /kun gyis zhes pa 'das ma 'ongs da ltar/ phyag byed gnas zhes pa sangs rgyas sras gcig po 'di/ yul rnams gcod pa'i ral grir snang*/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ yul rnams zhes pa dbang po sgo lnga'i/ gcod pa'i zhes pa rang sar/ ral grir snang zhes pa reg chod btags pas grol ba'i/ grol ba rnams ni 'di nyid la/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ grol ba zhes pa mthar thug yang dag par/ rnams ni zhes pa zhing khams rang dag tu sangs rgyas pa/ 'di nyid la zhes pa rgyud bstan pa'i bu gcig / rnam par brten nas grol ba'o/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ rnam par zhes pa sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi/ brten nas zhes pa 'gro ba sems can rnams/

grol ba'o zhes pa ka dag tu/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bu gcig po/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ sangs rgyas zhes pa ma rig pa sangs rig pa ye shes su rgyas pa'o/ /thams cad kyi zhes pa 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi sangs rgyas/ bu gcig po zhes pa bstan pa 'phel bar byed pa'i/ bstan pa rnams kyi btsas su byung ba/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ bstan pa zhes pa sangs rgyas kyi/ rnams kyi zhes pa mdo rgyud/ btsas su zhes pa phyis kyi/ byung pa zhes ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum las/ rang byung gi yi ge chen por bskal pa kun gyi thog mar rang byung*/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ rang byung gi zhes pa chos nyid rang sgras sus kyang byas pa med pa'i/ yi ge zhes pa gdul bya so sor rang rang gi chen por zhes pa lhun gyis grub pa'i/ bskal pa zhes pa grangs las 'das pa/ kun gyi zhes pa ma lus pa/ thog mar zhes pa dang po/ rang byung zhes pa ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje las/ byin brlabs las rang bkod pa/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ byin brlabs zhes pa sku gsum gyi/ rang bkod pa zhes pa yi ge rigs ni gcig pa tha dad du/ sprul pa sku'i sa bon 'phel bar byed pa/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ sprul pa zhes pa sangs rgyas kyi/ sku'i zhes pa bstan pa'i bdag po'i/ sa bon zhes pa rgyu sems can la/ 'phel bar zhes pa 'bras bu sangs rgyas thams cad du/ byed pa zhes pa rgyud sangs rgyas sras gcig po 'di dngos so/ /rab tu dkon pa'i tshig /ces pa'i don ni/ rab tu zhes pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du/ dkon pa'i tshig ces pa skal pa can 'ga' tsam ma gtogs pa/ su dag dang 'phrad par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes rgyud 'dus ma byas par bstan pa'i le'u ste bdun pa rdzogs so/ /sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya// // ༈ e ma/ las zad skal ldan sems kyi bu/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /thun mong man ngag bsams 'das kyang*/ /mchog gi man ngag sras gcig po/ /'di las zab pa zhing khams ni/

/mtha' med dag na yod re kan/ /des na dga' rab brgyud par bcas/ /yang dag mngon sangs rgya bar 'gyur/ /ci phyir rig pa dngos kyi gnad/ /'di la yod do sa mā ya/ /sngags srung rgyal mo lnga la gtad/ /skal ldan rnams dang 'phrad par shog /le'u re la gtor tshogs re/ /bla ma yi dam sngags srung mchog /spros bcas dang ni spros pa med/ / shin tu spros med rab spros med/ /dbang bzhi dag ni ma thob par/ /bstan cing bshad par mi bya'o/ /rgyud rgyal sangs rgyas sras gcig gi /gsang 'grel 'di bris mchog dge yis/ khams gsum sems can gnas dag nas/ /sku gsum ka nas dag gyur cig /bstan pa'i bu gcig 'di med na/ /bsgrubs kyang yun ring don med 'gyangs/ /des na 'di nyid mthing shun la/ /ston pa'i kha dog gser gyis 'bri/ /yig mgo ma log dar snas dril/ /spyi bo mgrin pa snying gar bcang*/ /de nyid grol bar the tshom med/ /thig le chen po'i btags grol ni/ / mthing shun brai zhabs lhag tsam la/ /dngul lam mtshal gyis mu khyud ni/ /thig le dpe'u chung lta bur bskor/ /dbus su lnga ldan rdo rje 'bri/ /phyi rim mu khyud ye shes lnga/ /snying po gser gyis 'bri bar bya/ /btags grol 'dus pa thig le che/ /dbyings gsum rig pa'i mthongs na gsal/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs las phyung*/ /dga' rab rdo rje bdag gis ga /de la rab tu gnas pa ni/ /tshes brgyad rgyal 'dzom dus na bya/ /yang na zla stod dag la 'o/ /thig le chen po'i dkyil 'khor la/ /nas kyi tshom bu bkod pa la/ /bla ma rigs lnga yab yum bskyed/ /tshogs dang gtor ma mchod pa 'bul/ /bgegs gtor btang la gsol ba gdab/ /thig le chen po'i snying po rnams/ /brgya 'am nyi shu rtsa gcig gdon/ /bkra shis brjod cing me tog gtor/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rab 'dus nas/ /btags grol 'od lnga'i gong bu yi/ /rigs lnga tshom bu nyid du bsgom/

/de ni rab tu gnas pa'o/ /de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ / dge bsnyen sdom dbog par bya/ /sdom yod rnams la mi dgos so/ /de nas rgyud de tshar gcig bklag /de nas skal ldan de nyid kyis/ /phyag ni brgya rtsa btsal bya zhing*/ /gser gyi maṇ+ḍal lan dgu dbul/ /rgyud dang theg le spyi bor bzhag /de las 'od byung snod bcud gang*/ /tshig 'dis gsol gdab dbang bskur ro/ / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras gcig pos/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi/ lus byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ grol bar mdzad du gsol/ gang bar mdzad du gsol/ cher 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang gnyis su med par byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo/ /gha dza kā ya a bhi ṣish+tsa ā+oṃ/ de nas rgyud nyid mgrin par bzhag / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras gcig pos/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i ngag byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes gong ltar brjod de/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung dang gnyis su med par byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo/ /gha tsa wa ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ de nas rgyud snying khar bzhag / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras gcig pos bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i yid byin gyis brlab du gsol/ zhes gong ltar brjod de/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs dang gnyis su med par byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo/ /dharmā tsita ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ de nas rgyud nyid lte bar bzhag / sangs rgyas thams cad gyi sras gcig pos bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i/ lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ grol bar mdzad du gsol/ gang bar mdzad du gsol/ cher 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo/ /kā ya waka tsit+ta dharma karma a bhi ṣiñca swāhā/

de nas thig le'i snying po rnams tshar gsum bklag ga /de nas gnas bzhir dbang bskur te/ dpon slob gnyis kyis tshig 'di nyid/ /lan gsum brjod la dar snas dril/ /drod dang ma bral bcang bar bya/ /phyogs bcu'i bla ma sangs rgyas rnams/ /ma lus brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis sems can don du ni/ /rgyud btags 'di bzhugs byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag mthong thos dang dran pa dang*/ /mchod dang bstod dang smra yang rung*/ /reg par gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /myur du mngon par sangs rgyas shog /bslab bya ni 'di dbugs la sleb dgos pas rbab dang chu dang 'chams ri ma dang gar 'chi cha med pas ma bral bar bcang bar bya'o/ / 'di btags nas dge ba ci byas pa brjod las 'das par 'phel bas/ dge ba'i las grub tshad sems can gyi don du byed pa gal che'o/ /'di btags nas sdig pa bsags na yang brjod las 'das par 'phel 'gro bas shin tu 'dzem pa gal che'o/ /'di nyid bzhugs pa'i skal pa can de ni sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i mchod rten du rigs par bya'o/ /skabs skabs su dri zhim po yang 'thul bar byed do/ /de ni lha dang mkha' 'gro ma'i mchod pa yod pa yin pas/ rgyud bklag par bya'o/ /rab tu gsang ba'i man ngag skal ldan gyi tsit+tar dha thim/ slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sras gcig rgyud kyi 'grel ba rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /sarba mad+ga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (1)btags pas grol bar bstan pa bu gcig gi gsang 'grel/ -PAGE 124--PAGE 123--68-
